$comment: Extensible Dashboard V4 contract catalog. Add new $defs for later DTOs; do not rename or reshape existing definitions. Connection, template, destination, and credential listings are secret-free. OnboardingCommitRequest.secretInput, CredentialRotateRequest.secretInput, and IdentityCredentialCreateRequest.secretInput are write-only.

AccountAuthScheme.description: Custom auth scheme. Wire values match V2 kebab-case.

AccountUpstreamProtocol.description: Custom/upstream protocol. Wire values match V2 snake_case.

AdapterKindDto.description: Sealed adapter kind. Wire values match the domain serde names.

AliasPublication.description:
Public names currently hidden from authenticated `GET /v1/models`.

Missing names default to published. Hidden names remain routable.

AliasPublicationUpdate.description:
Toggle one public name's downstream listing. `publicModel` is
case-folded on write.

AuthSchemeDto.description: Destination auth scheme. Wire values match the domain serde names.

AuthorizationState.description: Local authorization projection. Unknown is not a verified success.

BindingPatchRequest.description:
Required process-scoped mutation precondition.

Both fields travel at the top level of every mutation request. The random
process generation prevents a revision captured before restart from being
accepted by a fresh process whose in-memory counter reused the same value.

CapabilitiesDto.description: Destination capability flags. Mirrors the domain `Capabilities` record.

billingTierRequired.description: A billing tier must be selected before the destination is usable.

discoverableModels.description: The destination can discover models from the upstream.

externalIntegration.description: The destination is an external integration and holds no local inference secret.

identityHeaders.description: The adapter attaches identity headers on egress.

managedSignup.description: Managed signup can start an onboarding task on a credential.

observer.description: The destination holds a non-inference observer credential (platform parent).

officialBalanceProbe.description: Hosts Configurable HTTP may probe for an official current-balance API.

testable.description: Test connection is offered on every ready credential except external integrations.

CatalogModelDto.description: One catalog model on a destination.

upstreamModel.description: Upstream model id sent on egress.

CatalogModelsRemoveRequest.description:
Remove models from a persisted built-in Provider catalog snapshot.

Local-only. An official catalog refresh may add the same IDs back.

ConnectionLifecycle.description:
V4 connection lifecycle, including persisted onboarding drafts.

Draft is control-plane only: routing snapshots never carry it.

ControlRevision.description: Live CAS token, process generation, and pricing snapshot id.

CpaCatalogUpdate.description:
Required process-scoped mutation precondition.

Both fields travel at the top level of every mutation request. The random
process generation prevents a revision captured before restart from being
accepted by a fresh process whose in-memory counter reused the same value.

CredentialCooldownsDto.description: Per-window cooldown timestamps on a projected credential.

fiveHourUntil.description: Five-hour window cooldown expiry as RFC 3339, or null.

freeUntil.description: Free-window cooldown expiry as RFC 3339, or null.

genericUntil.description: Generic cooldown expiry as RFC 3339, or null.

monthUntil.description: Monthly window cooldown expiry as RFC 3339, or null.

weekUntil.description: Weekly window cooldown expiry as RFC 3339, or null.

CredentialGrantsDto.description: Allowed egress grants on a projected credential.

allowedEndpointIds.description: Endpoint ids this secret may be sent to.

allowedOrigins.description: Origins this secret may be sent to.

CredentialList.description: RFC credential list. Revision-tagged and secret-free.

CredentialRotateRequest.description:
Required process-scoped mutation precondition.

Both fields travel at the top level of every mutation request. The random
process generation prevents a revision captured before restart from being
accepted by a fresh process whose in-memory counter reused the same value.

DestinationCredentialDto.description: RFC credential projection row. Carries `hasSecret` only; never ciphertext or plaintext.

hasSecret.description: Whether a secret is stored. Always false for keyless Zen and CPA.

id.description: Stable credential id (deterministic UUIDv5 of the legacy account).

lastError.description: Last error string from the legacy account row, or null.

legacyAccountId.description:
The V3 `accounts` row this credential was projected from (migration-era
bridge to the V3 mutation routes).

purchaseDate.description: Purchase date when the destination has a Plan.

quotaPoolId.description: Shared quota pool id when the credential joined one.

routingRank.description: Position in the persisted account order.

DestinationDto.description: RFC destination projection row. Secret-free; field-for-field from the domain `Destination`.

baseUrl.description: Upstream origin. Sealed for builtin adapters; user data for `http`.

brandFamily.description: Brand family for grouping, when the adapter or platform kind has one.

id.description: Stable destination id (deterministic UUIDv5 of the legacy row).

legacy.description: V3 row this destination was projected from.

maxCredentials.description: `1` for singletons and account-owned endpoints; `null` otherwise.

observerCredentialId.description: Non-inference observer credential id when `capabilities.observer` is set.

DestinationList.description: RFC destination list. Revision-tagged and secret-free.

DestinationOnboardingTaskDto.description: Managed-signup task on a projected credential. Domain shape; no task id.

DestinationProjectionRefusedError.description: 409 envelope when `destination_projection` refuses. Same V3 fields plus `details`.

DshApplicationInstallRequest.description:
Required process-scoped mutation precondition.

Both fields travel at the top level of every mutation request. The random
process generation prevents a revision captured before restart from being
accepted by a fresh process whose in-memory counter reused the same value.

EligibilityReason.description: Why a connection is eligible or not. `None` is a successful Eligible row.

EligibilityState.description: Local attempt eligibility. Unknown authorization may still be Eligible.

EndpointAuthScheme.description:
Auth advertised on a connection endpoint. `Sealed` is used for built-in
adapters whose scheme is owned by code, not by the projected row.

EndpointOperation.description:
Inference operation advertised by one endpoint. Mapped 1:1 from
[`UpstreamProtocolKind`].

ExpiryCadenceDto.description: How a Plan expires, when it has a cadence.

IdentityCredentialCreateRequest.description:
Required process-scoped mutation precondition.

Both fields travel at the top level of every mutation request. The random
process generation prevents a revision captured before restart from being
accepted by a fresh process whose in-memory counter reused the same value.

LegacyConnectionKind.description: Pre-unification row a connection was projected from.

LegacyDestinationKindDto.description: Which V3-era row a destination was projected from.

oneOf.description: Account-owned Custom API endpoint; `id` is the account id.
New API / Sub2API site; `id` is the platform parent id.

LegacyDestinationRefDto.description:
Migration-era bridge from a projected destination back to the V3 row that
still owns its mutations. Removed once destinations become primary.

id.description: Row id in the V3 model named by `kind`.

period.description: `all`, or DeepSeek `peak` / `off_peak` at the frozen attempt time.

OnboardingCommitRequest.description:
Required process-scoped mutation precondition.

Both fields travel at the top level of every mutation request. The random
process generation prevents a revision captured before restart from being
accepted by a fresh process whose in-memory counter reused the same value.

authorizeCurrentEndpoint.description:
Explicit consent to union safe current default/same-origin grants.
Ignored unless `mode` is present; false is omitted from the digest.

mode.description: Omitted preserves legacy commit behavior and HMAC digest bytes.

accountId.description: Legacy receipts omit this; replay emits null via serde default.

configuration.description: Required when `mode` is present. Legacy mode-None existing rejects this.

PlanDto.description: Commercial offering embedded in a destination. Mirrors the domain `Plan`.

manualCalibration.description: Operators may enter local usage numbers by hand.

PlatformKeyImportRequest.description: Import New API inference tokens as local Custom Keys. Secret-free.

PricingSourceDto.description: Where a Plan's prices come from.

ProtocolDto.description: Wire protocol for destination catalog and transport rows.

ProviderDefinitionAuthKind.description:
Auth kind owned by a Provider definition. Independent of protocol.
Nullable on the wire because builtin rows leave the field empty.

RedirectPolicyDto.description: Redirect policy advertised on a destination.

RefusedRowDto.description: Identity of one legacy row the stage-4a projection refused.

providerId.description: Provider id when the refused row is an account.

RefusedRowKindDto.description: Legacy row kind named in a destination-projection refusal.

UsageSourceDto.description: Where a Plan reads usage from.

V3Error.description: Stable non-2xx JSON envelope for every Dashboard V3 error.
